_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
Say ka ampanmo a Golf (Card Game) - Player {player_id}.
Goal: Get say lowest total score a diad single round. No say columns share say same value, say anggad summed a 0.
Card Values: A=1, 2-10=face value, J/Q=10, K=0

Actions (usaren exact brackets):
- '[draw]' - Draw manlapud deck
- '[take]' - Take manlapud discard pile
- '[swap X Y]' - Swap drawn card with position X (row) Y (column)
- '[discard]' - Discard say drawn card

board.drew:
Nidrew ka: {card}
Natan, say ka must [swap X Y] or [discard] it.
board.took:
Nintook ka: {card} manlapud discard pile
Say ka must [swap X Y] it (agga cannot discard).

options.final_turns: Final turns! Say impanmo a options: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: Kaukolan mon: [swap X Y] (agmo naekal iray kard ed saray karga ya isesebel)
options.swap_or_discard: Say ka must: [swap X Y] or [discard]

hand.header: Kol: 1 2 3 Saray kol ya agni apigeren et 12

action_desc.swapped: Inswap na {pid} so {new} ed {old} diad posisyon ({row},{col})

message.deck_empty: Anggapo lay karga na deck! Asumpal a tampol so laro.
message.knocked: Kinabog na {pid}! Makarekord pay metung a turno kada arum a mangilista.
message.final_round: Agmamano {pid} {reason}! Minayam ya isan toka so arum a agmamano.

invalid.wrong_action: Usaren mo exactly ONE bracketed action: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], or [peek X Y]
invalid.discard_empty: Anggapo lay karga na saray basura!
invalid.must_draw_first: Say ka must umuna a [draw], [take], [knock], or [peek X Y]
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: Agmo nayarin ibantak so sakey a kard ya inala ed saray karga na panangibantak, nepeg mon salatan itan.
invalid.have_drawn_card: Wala kay naidik na karta. Nabalang kay man [swap X Y] o [discard] ita.

invalid.need_drawn_discard: Kaukolan moy aka-draw a kard pian naekal itan.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Position out of bounds. Usaren mo row 1-{max_row}, column 1-{max_col}

invalid.already_knocked: Walay sakey a nanggawa la na sayan round.
